**PJB** is the original OrcaSlicer 2.4.2 with Pawel Jarczak's Bambu network-plugin bridge added, so Bambu cloud printers keep working. On Windows the plugin runs inside a bundled WSL2 runtime; on Linux it runs natively. We plan to rebuild it for every official OrcaSlicer release to stay in sync with upstream.

## What's new
- **Fedora:** opening the camera live view no longer closes the application.

## Known issues
- **Windows:** with cloud-connected printers, the camera shows `Connection Failed [1:403]` and sending print jobs fails with a 403 error, so this build is of limited use on Windows for now. Printer status and filament info still work. A fix is planned for the next release.

## Downloads
| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows | `OrcaSlicer_Windows_Installer_V2.4.2_x64.exe` (installer) or `OrcaSlicer_Windows_V2.4.2_portable.zip` |
| Ubuntu / Debian | `.deb` for Ubuntu 22.04 or 24.04, or the `LinuxDir` `.tar.gz` (unpack and run) |
| Any Linux | `OrcaSlicer-BMCU_Linux_AppImage_…AppImage` |
| Fedora 41–44 | `.rpm` for your Fedora version |
